title: EstimateReply
description: The parsed form of a estimate reply (a chain's cost estimate and the host's insert verdict on its last member): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

cpu_percent.description: The estimated CPU load in percent.

ram_bytes.description: The estimated memory in bytes, or - when none is known.

unknown_count.description: How many members have no figure.

unknown.description: The members with no figure, each its position and its code.

position.description: The member's position in the line.

code.description: The code that says why there is no figure.

ram_used_bytes.description: The memory in use in bytes, or -.

ram_added_bytes.description: The memory the chain adds in bytes, or -.

ram_budget_bytes.description: The memory budget in bytes, or -.

ram_unknown_count.description: How many members have no memory figure.

verdict.description: The host's insert verdict on the candidate, the last member: a word of the domain estimate's ESTIMATE_VERDICTS.

reason.description: The word of the domain estimate's ESTIMATE_REASONS that gave the verdict.
